subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/898, or close it and land a narrow replacement in openclaw/openclaw?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open conflicting fork PR already uses closing syntax and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not queue a competing fix until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Adopt or replace the fork fix
options.body: Review the fork PR, then either refresh/adopt it or close it and land an equivalent narrow main-repo fix.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to resolve conflicts and provide updated proof.
